# `<sl-empty-state>` — Empty State

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Empty states communicate that a list or view has no content yet, e.g. a document with no review comments.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/empty-state/empty-state.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title-text` | `titleText` | `string` | `''` | The title text shown below the icon. |
| `description` | — | `string` | `''` | The supporting description text shown below the title. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | An icon shown in the tinted badge above the title, e.g. `<sl-icon>`. |
| `action` | An optional call to action, e.g. a `<sl-button>` to add the first item. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `icon` | The tinted circular badge that hosts the icon. |
| `title` | The title. |
| `description` | The supporting description text. |
| `action` | The container that wraps the action slot. |

## Documentation and examples

Use an empty state in place of a list or view when there's nothing to show yet, e.g. a document with no review
comments. Set `title-text` and `description` for the message, use the `icon` slot for a representative icon, and the
`action` slot for an optional call to action.

```html
<sl-empty-state title-text="No comments yet" description="Be the first to leave a comment on this document.">
  <sl-icon slot="icon" name="chat-left-text"></sl-icon>
  <sl-button slot="action" variant="primary">+ Add comment</sl-button>
</sl-empty-state>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/button/button.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/empty-state/empty-state.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/icon/icon.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empty-state-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-empty-state title-text="No comments yet" description="Be the first to leave a comment on this document.">
      <sl-icon slot="icon" name="chat-left-text"></sl-icon>
      <sl-button slot="action" variant="primary">+ Add comment</sl-button>
    </sl-empty-state>
  `
})
export class EmptyStateExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Without an action

The `action` slot is optional — its container collapses when it's empty.

```html
<sl-empty-state title-text="No activity yet" description="Activity will appear here once this document is shared.">
  <sl-icon slot="icon" name="clock-history"></sl-icon>
</sl-empty-state>
```

### Without an icon

The `icon` slot is also optional and collapses the same way.

```html
<sl-empty-state title-text="No results found" description="Try adjusting your filters."></sl-empty-state>
```
